text:
maria (eng-ml): Heads up — PR #8420 is ready for review. Adds INT8 quant loader + runtime fallback to float when unsupported. This touches KV cache serialization and the model loader. Need runtime + infra + security eyes for a canary scheduled tomorrow at 11:00 PT. Link: https://github.com/redwood/pr/8420

raj (eng-runtime): Taking a runtime look now. Any perf numbers or regression risks? I see a couple of microbench results in CI but want a summary.

maria (eng-ml): Perf summary in the PR description and perf/bench.md: overall ~3% CPU reduction on the quant path, p50 12ms -> 11.4ms, p95 45ms -> 46ms (within noise). Memory delta +2% on our test harness. No change to the KV cache eviction policy.

jordan (eng-infra): Quick infra note: the cache serialization format bump means data on-disk changes. Is this behind a feature flag and do we have a migration plan? If not, infra needs a migration job and a rollback path.

maria (eng-ml): It's behind a flag: `quant_loader_rollout`. I added a migration script at infra/migrations/8420_migrate_cache.sh and a one-liner to run it. CC @jordan for validation.

sophie (eng-security): Security question: does the new serialization ever deserialize data that could originate from an untrusted source (uploads, user-supplied blobs)? If so we need to audit the deserializer and add explicit safelists.

maria (eng-ml): No user-supplied data — only internal model KV blobs and tokenizer ids. Added unit tests and a static assert: ``assert_no_untrusted_deserialize=true``. Also added a note in PR about defensive checks.

alex (eng-platform): Platform FYI: the rollout needs a 2-zone canary policy before global. We'll need the canary window in the release calendar and the rollout policy updated to require zone parity. Can you confirm desired window?

maria (eng-ml): Requesting a 1-hour canary starting 11:00 PT tomorrow. If runtime + infra + security give thumbs, we'll merge now and kick the canary.

raj (eng-runtime): Left one inline about bumping KV cache version constant. It's a tiny change. If maintainers ok, I'll LGTM after that and watch the kv cache path in staging.

jordan (eng-infra): Migration script looks fine. Please add an explicit rollback step in the PR description in case the migration needs to be reverted mid-canary.

maria (eng-ml): Done — added rollback steps + short runbook (how to flip `quant_loader_rollout` off and run the revert script). Also gated the new loader behind the flag at startup. Ping @alex to schedule canary and @sophie for final sign-off.

sophie (eng-security): Quick review done. Leaving one non-blocking comment re: log redaction when we log malformed KV entries. Not blocking the canary.

alex (eng-platform): Scheduling canary at 11:00 PT tomorrow and adding to the release calendar now. I'll apply a two-zone canary policy and set monitoring hooks. Marking PR as ready for canary once runtime LGTM.

raj (eng-runtime): Updated PR with KV version bump as requested. PTAL. If CI stays green I'll give LGTM.

ci-bot: CI passed for PR #8420 on main — all checks green.

maria (eng-ml): Thanks all. If no further objections I'll merge in ~10m and kick off the canary tomorrow. I'll monitor p50/p95 dashboards and error budget; posting notes to the incident channel if we see abnormal signs. :eyes:
